item.title: 1.4 The Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neuron
item.description: The Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neuron A spike event gives an SNN a compact way to say, “something worth sending happened at this moment.” Once information is carried by events, a neuron needs a simple rule for deciding when silence should continue and when a new spike should be emitted.
